metadata.scenario: A customer calls to dispute a charge on their bill, claiming they were overcharged for a recent service. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is David Anderson. I'm calling to dispute a charge on my recent bill. I'm sorry to hear that, David. Could you please provide me with some details about the charge? Sure, I was billed for skilled nursing care, but I believe I was overcharged. It looks like I was charged $125 for a visit that should have been $95. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your account so I can take a look at the details. One moment please. Alright, I have your account here. It looks like the charge for skilled nursing care was processed at the higher end of the range. Can you tell me the date of the visit in question? Yes, it was on October 5th. Thank you. I see the visit was indeed billed at $125. May I ask if there were any additional services provided during that visit? No, it was just the basic care. My wife was monitored, but that should still be $95, right? Typically, yes. However, if there were any unusual circumstances that required more time or resources, it may explain the higher charge. I don’t think there were any unusual circumstances. I want to ensure we’re only paying for what we need. Absolutely, I can understand that. I will need to review the visit notes to confirm the charge. Okay, how long will that take? I can follow up with our billing department today and get back to you by tomorrow at the latest. That sounds good. Thank you, Margaret. You're welcome, David. Is there anything else I can help you with while I have you on the line? Yes, actually. My wife also needs physical therapy after her stroke. We can definitely help with that. Dr. James Rodriguez, our physical therapist, specializes in stroke recovery. Great! What’s the cost for physical therapy? It’s between $110 and $140 per session, depending on the specific needs. I see. Can I schedule an evaluation with him? Absolutely, I can have our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, reach out to you to set that up. Awesome! Just to confirm, I will follow up with you regarding the billing dispute and schedule the evaluation. Yes, that works for me. Thank you for your understanding, David. You’ll hear back from us soon. Thank you, Margaret. Have a good day. You too, take care!
